actions.explanation: Confirm which plan includes the API.

observation.content: API access is available on Pro and Business. Starter does not include API access, so Starter workspaces cannot create or use API tokens. Workspace Admins can create tokens from developer settings. Tokens inherit access to their workspace and should be stored like passwords.

Starter has no API allowance because API access is unavailable on that plan. Monthly allowances reset at the beginning of the workspace's billing period. Unused requests do not carry forward.

callouts: Two limits apply: Requests must remain within both the monthly allowance and the plan's per-minute limit.
